definition: Sebastian Raschka is the author of 'Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)' and 'Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn'.
details: Created `mlxtend`, contributed to LitGPT at Lightning AI, and is one of the foremost educators and authors in practical deep learning engineering.

explainer.lead: Sebastian Raschka is a researcher. His work spans bioinformatics and data.
